## Description

What are you changing and why? Link an issue if relevant.

## Security and testing checklist

- [ ] Changes are scoped to this request.
- [ ] I ran `npm test` with Node 22+ or documented why it was NOT RUN.
- [ ] No API keys, secrets, customer data, personal context or other private material is included.
- [ ] Tests use synthetic/mock data and do not send live TypeSafe/JEV requests.
- [ ] Changes do not introduce privileged fork execution, secret access, unexpected runner costs, or auto-merge.
- [ ] Any workflow or authorization change is explicitly flagged for owner review.

## Evidence

Paste a concise summary of the real test result (not secrets or unredacted payloads).

Maintainer review is required. Passing tests does not authorize automatic merging or paid API requests.
